'''Big Poppa''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is a member of the [[Los Santos Vagos]] and one of the biggest drug dealers in [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. He is not voiced in his [[A Home in the Hills|only appearance]].

==Character history==
Big Poppa, at an unknown time prior to [[1992]], became a member of the [[Los Santos Vagos]] and later a drug dealer, presumably rising through the ranks to become a leader. In 1992 he takes control of [[Madd Dogg's Crib]] after giving him a large supply of drugs, while Madd Dogg was in a state of depression. [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]], who had stopped Madd Dogg from [[Madd Dogg (mission)|committing suicide]] and later became his manager, works alongside the [[San Fierro Triads]] to [[A Home in the Hills|invade and take back]] his mansion from Big Poppa and his Vagos henchmen equipped with high tech guns in a grueling gunfight. Big Poppa, however, leaves the mansion and tries to escape in his [[Phoenix|car]] but is chased down and killed by Carl.

== Trivia ==
* Big Poppa owns a [[Phoenix]], a very rare sports car, in which he tries to escape from Carl.
* Big Poppa does not get an individual character design but a generic Los Santos Vagos design.
* Big Poppa is named after the 1994 The Notorious B.I.G song [[wp:Big Poppa|Big Poppa]].
